purpose: habitat-sim 0.2.4 -> 0.3.1 engine switch and velocity control acceptance

habitat_sim.same_commit_as: aihabitat conda habitat-sim=0.3.1 py3.9 build used by LightNav-0 habitat_server

discrete_replay_parity.method: Replay recorded native actions of the prompt-v2 ckpt1000 runs (produced on 0.2.4 by the code snapshot whose implementation hashes match run.json) in both engines; compare per-step positions, collisions and recomputed metrics.

rendering.consequence: Physics and metrics are unchanged; pixels are not. Scores produced on 0.3.1 are a new evaluation identity and are not pooled with 0.2.4 results.

discrete_replay_parity.porting_fix: 0.3.1 SensorSpec.position/orientation require magnum.Vector3; Python lists are rejected.

velocity_smoke.dataset: r2r_val_unseen_lightnav episode 10, camera lightnav_fwd120 (480x270, hfov 120, 0.88 m, level)
velocity_smoke.note: Steps slightly above 0.25 m occur when try_step re-projects the agent onto the navmesh while sliding; the same filter is used by habitat-lab VelocityAction. Equivalence to habitat-lab itself is established separately by the LightNav-0 reference comparison.
